newsitem.title: INDIA: India Sterlite commissions copper smelter.
newsitem.headline: India Sterlite commissions copper smelter.

text.p: Sterlite Industries (India) Ltd said on Tuesday it commissioned a 100,000 tonnes a year copper smelting and refining project.
"Trial runs are over and regular production is about to stabilise," it said in a statement.
Sterlite said its project has been set up with technology from MIM Holdings, Australia, and Chemtics of Canada. It was completed in two years without any cost over-run, it said.
Sterlite said India's demand for copper was currently around 250,000 tonnes a year and is expected to grow to 400,000 tonnes a year within the next four years.
"Domestic production is presently only 50,000 tonnes a year leaving a huge supply-demand gap, which is met by imports."
Sterlite said its copper smelter will go a long way in bridging the gap.
